Join UCLA Health and play a key role in transforming complex data into meaningful insights that drive quality improvement, operational excellence, and strategic decision-making.

This position provides programming, database development and management, and advanced technical and analytical data support to the Performance Strategy and Analytics department. The position supports reporting and data submissions to internal service lines, clinical leadership, and external agencies for quality initiatives, regulatory programs, and collaboratives. This includes designing, building, and testing quality and performance indicators and metrics; developing data extracts and datasets from the electronic health record and other enterprise data sources; and maintaining dashboards and reports used to monitor clinical quality and operational performance. The position also performs data validation to ensure the accuracy of reported measures and supports the automation and optimization of recurring data processes.

The successful candidate is a proactive, innovative thinker who thrives in a team environment, embraces technical challenges, and is passionate about using data and automation to drive meaningful organizational impact.

This position transitioned from being included in the University’s Professional & Support Staff Program to being represented by the TX bargaining unit. To learn more about your representation, visit: https://ucnet.universityofcalifornia.edu/labor/bargaining-units/
